evidence.note: Blue marks only the agent-run dots/edges (legend 'Agent Run'), the active timeline marker and the lock badge; everything else is neutral grey/ink.
Past timeline markers turn grey and the current item stays dark; blue is not reused for emphasis on prose text.
Blue agent dot and flag, blue 'scorer check' pill for the accepted path; red X used only on 'scorer reads it' as the failure/alarm state.
Coordinator drawn in black ink matching its legend role; boxes and arrows neutral, no decorative colour.
Red appears only on 'Sacrificed' dots, declared in the legend as the loss role; the current step marker 3 is the blue focus colour.
Section kicker and active nav item use a darker blue text tone, consistent with an accent-ink role rather than the fill accent.

rationale: Across the steps blue consistently encodes focus/agent runs, black encodes coordinators and red is reserved for loss (sacrificed runs) and the failure X, each declared in the legend or by context. No role colour appears as decoration or as emphasis for an unrelated role, and the palette reads coherently without clashes. This matches the pass descriptor.
